notes.title: v2.15 (Beta Demo) - Qaulity of Life & Patch
notes.notes:
There are now arrows pointing towards the targets during minigames. This fixes the problem of targets being hard to find.
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43882854/2d36b1b978c88525c3427f216c10f0a397caf9e2.jpg
Also some small changes to the quest menu layout to make it clearer that minigames are separate and cannot be "completed"
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43882854/7b04af2f8095d891e9a7ad7711e78f3e5b490436.jpg
And of course a bunch of bug fixes, full patch notes:
• Added UI arrows to the throwing and racing minigames
• Clarified the different quest types
• Improved campfire collision
• Fixed bug with camera being tilted after using glider
• Fixed bug with creatures attacking a players companion creature
• Fixed bug with one of the air pocket bounds
• Fixed bug where inventory could not be used after washing up on shore
• Fixed bug with weather change when waking up on shore
• Fixed bug where an item could sometimes not be picked up
• Fixed bug with bubble particles sometimes going above water surface
• Fixed bug with gamepad prompt showing in the menu when not using gamepad
• Fixed bug with gamepad initialization in game menu
• Fixed bug with gamepad when scrolling through guide entry
• Fixed bug with quests not updating in game menu
• Fixed typo
